description: The simulation data for the paper "Continuation Power Flow Model of Multi-area AC/DC Interconnected Systems incorporating VSC-MTDC is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Chong Ding. Simulation test data for the paper "Continuation Power Flow Model of Multi-area AC/DC Interconnected Systemsincorporating VSC-MTDC" are attached. Model M1 refers to the proposed CPF model. The nonlinear constraint equations of the directional trading activepower (DTAP) derived from the bilateral power trading contracts (BPTC) are considered. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
